name: Licenciate Thesis/Economics and Business Administration
learningOutcomes: The final thesis required for the licentiate degree is the licentiate thesis, in which the student demonstrates a good knowledge of his/her field of research and the ability to apply scientific research methods independently and with due criticism. The university may also accept as a licentiate thesis a) a number of scientific publications or manuscripts accepted for publication it deems sufficient, or a summary of such publications or b) a work that meets equivalent scientific criteria. The publications may also include collective publications if the doctoral candidate has independently and demonstrably prepared a part of it.

name: Dissertation/Economics and Business Administration
learningOutcomes: A dissertation is the final thesis required for the doctoral degree that has to be defended in a public examination. A dissertation shall contribute new scientific knowledge to its field. It may be a monograph or an article-based dissertation consisting of refereed scientific publications on the research topic and a summary of them.
